messages:
aesha: Heads-up: partner asked for an EU-only pilot combining Snowflake External Functions, Databricks Unity Catalog policy mapping, and a Milvus vector node in their Frankfurt DC. Need checklist.
marco: High level: network path + data residency + auth flow. For Snowflake we need a partner role with usage tag + external function integration to call our inference endpoint.
rachel: I've sketched a minimal acceptance test: ingest 500 rows, run embedding + upsert to Milvus, run 20 similarity queries, validate recall >=0.88 and 95th pct latency <250ms.
marco: For Unity Catalog we must map the service principal to a read-only materialization role for the delta table used by the connector. Rachel can you drop a snippet?
rachel: snippet for RBAC mapping (Databricks SQL):
```sql
CREATE USER redwood_connector PRINCIPAL 'redwood-connector@partner.com';
GRANT SELECT ON CATALOG retail_catalog TO redwood_connector;
```
aesha: Security note: partner requires KMS key in EU and audit logs forwarded to their Splunk. We'll provision a customer-managed key alias and a short-lived cross-account role. Sam can handle infra.
sam: I will add terraform module infra/partner-eu-pilot with: vpc peering, kms key alias, cross-account role, and a one-node milvus helm chart in their VPC via partner-ssh tunnel. ETA Friday.
marco: Packaging for cloud marketplace: two artifacts - 1) listing tile (marketing copy + screenshots) 2) deployable recipe for private deployment (terraform + helm). Need product copy from @aesha.
aesha: Draft copy: "Redwood & Partner: Secure embeddings and retrieval for EU data stores. One-click private pilot with audit-ready logs." Will add screenshots post-demo.
rachel: Also gating QA: schema drift check, embedding stability (cosine change <0.05 after model update), and backpressure handling in connector (retry & dead-letter). Add healthcheck spec: {status: ok, last_ingest_ts, backlog_count}.
sam: deploy-bot: provisioning job queued -> pilot-eu-117 :rocket:
deploy-bot: pilot-eu-117 scheduled by sam for 2024-05-20T09:00Z - resources: vpc-peer, kms, milvus-node
aesha: Ops question: do we require mTLS between connector and Milvus? partner says they can accept API-key only for now, but prefer certs in prod. We'll document both.
marco: Can we add a simple smoke harness in repo tests/partner-pilots/eu that runs the acceptance test end-to-end and emits a JUnit report? That will speed sign-off.
rachel: I'll push a pytest harness that does ingest->embed->query and asserts recall/latency. Expect minor flakiness; will add retries and mark flaky tests.
aesha: Action items:
- sam: terraform + helm recipe, open PR (due Thu)
- rachel: pytest smoke harness + expected metrics (due Wed)
- marco: marketplace artifact checklist + legal data residency blurb (due Wed)
- aesha: draft marketing copy + demo script (due Thu)
- all: sync Thu 10:30 CET to validate readiness
marco: partner success will need a runbook for handoff. I'll create runbook/partner-eu-pilot.md with steps for keys, support contacts, and rollback.
sam: noted. tagging @ops-channel once infra PR is ready.
aesha: thanks everyone, this keeps the timeline tight for next-week pilot. :thumbsup:
